purpose.objective: Build a point-in-time research dataset for oil and CNY/RUB hypotheses without modifying or weakening existing source contracts.

phase6_identity_and_price_lineage.source_panel_binding: The explicit Phase 6 source D1 panel must reproduce the frozen Phase 6 target dates, instrument identities and all Phase 6 feature columns through the existing Phase 6 builder semantics. A source close may enter a forward label only when a subsequent frozen lagged Phase 6 feature row binds that source row; the terminal source row has no subsequent witness and is forbidden as a label endpoint.

cnyrubf.future_enablement_policy: oil_fx_full remains forbidden by this contract even if a caller supplies candidate-looking evidence; a separate additive admission contract must pin the accepted post-fix CNYRUBF runtime artifacts before full mode can be enabled

oil_fx_full.authorization_condition: separate additive admission contract after post-fix CNYRUBF controlled runtime proves G1-G9 PASS and pins exact accepted artifact hashes

point_in_time_policy.brent_cross_contract_return_policy: return is null unless every selected contract code across the complete lookback window is identical

structural_nulls_allowed: Brent same-contract close returns at insufficient lookback or any roll-crossing window
CNYRUBF lagged returns/open-interest change at insufficient lookback after future admission
Forward labels whose endpoint would consume the terminal Phase 6 source row because that row has no subsequent lagged-feature witness

label_policy.price_source: explicit Phase 6 source D1 panel after semantic replay binding to the frozen Phase 6 modeling dataset; terminal source close is excluded from label endpoints because it lacks a subsequent lagged-feature witness

gates.G1_identity_and_phase6_lineage: exact 472 frozen eligible identities plus semantic replay of the explicit D1 source panel against the frozen Phase 6 modeling dataset; terminal source close is not admitted as a label endpoint because it has no subsequent lagged-feature witness
gates.G2_brent_admission: exact SHA256-pinned Phase 8.4A accepted Brent matrix, gate evidence and input-identity evidence only; no regeneration
gates.G3_cnyrubf_stage_policy: brent_only forbids CNYRUBF; oil_fx_full is unconditionally forbidden by this v1.0 contract until a separate additive admission contract exists
gates.G4_pit: all source rows equal prior_trade_date; no same-day/future/fill/interpolation/latest fallback
gates.G5_brent_roll_integrity: cross-contract return is never computed; structural null is required across a roll
gates.G6_leakage: feature artifact contains no labels, targets, predictions, probabilities or future prices
gates.G7_numerical: non-null derived numeric features are finite and source OHLC/volume inputs pass local sanity checks
gates.G8_label_separation: forward labels are produced only in a separate artifact, preserve identity order, and never consume the unbound terminal source close
gates.G9_final: mode is ready only if all mode-applicable gates pass
